requirements.title: Direct Benefit Transfer to PFMS
requirements.description: The system shall process and disburse scholarship payments through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is sanctioned, When the system pushes the payment to PFMS, Then the payment shall be initiated via PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

requirements.title: Single Instalment Payment Deadline
requirements.description: The system shall disburse the scholarship amount in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the academic year is 2026-27, When the disbursement date approaches, Then the system shall ensure the single instalment is paid by 31 March.

requirements.title: Payment Failure Handling and Re-initiation
requirements.description: The system shall handle DBT payment failures in PFMS by notifying the student to correct bank details within 30 days and re-initiating the payment in the next weekly batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a DBT payment fails in PFMS, When the failure is recorded, Then the system shall notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days.

requirements.title: Grievance Resolution Workflow
requirements.description: The system shall provide an online grievance facility to applicants and resolve grievances within 7 working days of receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance is received, When the grievance is logged, Then the system shall resolve the grievance within 7 working days.

requirements.title: SMS Notification at Processing Stages
requirements.description: The system shall send an SMS to the applicant at every stage of processing of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the application is submitted, When the application is verified, Then the system shall inform the applicant by SMS.

requirements.title: Monthly Report to Principal Secretary
requirements.description: The system shall generate and submit a monthly report to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the end of each month, When the report is generated, Then the system shall submit the monthly report to the Principal Secretary.

requirements.title: Dashboard for District Social Welfare Officer
requirements.description: The system shall provide a dashboard to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the District Social Welfare Officer logs in, When the dashboard is accessed, Then the dashboard shall display district-wise status of applications.

requirements.title: Renewal Application Processing
requirements.description: The system shall process renewal applications by reusing documents already verified in the previous year and not requiring them to be uploaded again.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a renewal application is submitted, When the system processes the application, Then documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and not uploaded again.

requirements.title: Low-End Device and Network Compatibility
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the portal is available on low-end Android phones and functions on 3G connections.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the portal is accessed from a low-end Android phone, When the connection is 3G, Then the portal shall remain accessible and functional.

requirements.title: Mobile Application Access
requirements.description: The system shall provide a mobile application for students, as most students have only a mobile phone.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a student accesses the system via a mobile phone, When the mobile application is available, Then the student shall be able to use the mobile application.

requirements.title: Application Rejection Reason Communication
requirements.description: The system shall communicate the reason for application rejection to the student by SMS and provide one chance to correct and re-apply.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an application is rejected, When the rejection is processed, Then the system shall tell the student the reason for rejection by SMS.

requirements.title: Data Retention and Anonymisation
requirements.description: The system shall retain applicant data for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymise it.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the last payment is made, When 8 years have passed, Then the system shall anonymise the applicant data.

requirements.title: Audit Trail Logging
requirements.description: The system shall log all status changes, data edits, and exports, and make the audit trail viewable by the State administrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a status change or data edit occurs, When the action is performed, Then the action shall be logged and the audit trail shall be viewable by the State administrator.

requirements.title: Application Submission Channels
requirements.description: The system shall receive applications online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
acceptanceCriteria: Given an applicant submits an application, When the submission is made, Then the application shall be received online via the scholarship portal or CSCs.

requirements.title: Aadhaar-Based e-KYC Mandate
requirements.description: The system shall mandatorily perform Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant during application submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the e-KYC process is initiated, Then Aadhaar-based e-KYC shall be performed.

requirements.title: Caste and Income Certificate Verification
requirements.description: The system shall obtain caste and income certificates from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the applicant submits the application, When the certificate is required, Then the system shall obtain the certificate from DigiLocker or accept the upload in Annexure A.

requirements.title: Sanction within Right to Service Timeline
requirements.description: The system shall ensure the scholarship is sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, as notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a complete application is submitted, When the sanction process begins, Then the scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days.

requirements.title: Data Usage Limitation
requirements.description: The system shall ensure personal data collected under the scheme is used only for the purposes of the scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Given personal data is collected, When the data is processed, Then the data shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.

requirements.title: Mobile Number Acknowledgement for CSC Applications
requirements.description: The system shall send the acknowledgement for applications submitted through CSC operators to the student's mobile number.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a CSC operator submits an application on behalf of a student, When the application is submitted, Then the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.

requirements.title: Pre-filled Renewal Application
requirements.description: The system shall send pre-filled renewal applications to last year's beneficiaries when the renewal window opens on 1 July.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the renewal window opens on 1 July, When a last year's beneficiary accesses the system, Then the system shall provide a pre-filled renewal application.

requirements.title: Escalation on SLA Breach
requirements.description: The system shall escalate institution delays to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an institution delay occurs, When the delay is detected, Then the system shall escalate the delay to the District Social Welfare Officer.

requirements.title: Beneficiary Master Data Migration
requirements.description: The system shall migrate only 2025-26 beneficiaries as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications shall not be migrated.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the data migration process is initiated, When the legacy data is processed, Then only 2025-26 beneficiaries shall be migrated as a beneficiary master.

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.

blocks.SUPERSEDED:
[GO-3.2] superseded by COR1-1: The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only).
[MIN-4] superseded by GO-5.1: Institution verification shall be completed within 10 days of submission.
blocks.RESOLUTIONS:
[RES-1] Supersession GO-3.2, COR1-1: COR1-1 prevails.
[RES-2] Conflict GO-5.1, MIN-4: GO-5.1 prevails.
[RES-3] MissingReference GO-4.3: deferred to the department (open issue).
blocks.ANSWERS:
[ANS-1] When a DBT payment fails in PFMS (for example the account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed), what should happen to the application? Answer: Notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in the next weekly batch
[ANS-2] Can a student appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and to whom? Answer: Appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days
blocks.ASSUMPTIONS:
[ASM-3] Legacy data migration: Only 2025-26 beneficiaries are migrated as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications are not migrated.
[ASM-4] Escalation on SLA breach: Institution delays are escalated to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
[ASM-5] Renewal: The renewal window opens on 1 July and last year's beneficiaries receive a prefilled renewal application.
[ASM-6] Data retention: Applicant data is retained for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymised.
[ASM-7] Audit: All status changes, data edits and exports are logged, and the audit trail is viewable by the State administrator.
